cv.title: Your CV and cover letter
cv.lead: The CV is the first thing an employer in Germany sees from you. Bring it into German format before you send the first application.
cv.downloadError: The download could not be started. Please try again.

profiles.title: Your profile for German recruiters
profiles.lead: Recruiters in Germany search LinkedIn and XING by job title, skills and location. Work through the checklist so that your profile turns up in those searches and holds up when someone opens it.

intro.linkedin: LinkedIn is the network most international employers in Germany use to find candidates. A complete profile is also what recruiters open after reading your application.
intro.xing: XING is the professional network of the German-speaking market. Many medium-sized companies and German recruiters still search here.

profiles.lockTitle: The Free plan shows the basics.
profiles.lockText: The full checklists for LinkedIn and XING, with examples and message templates, are included from the {{plan}} plan.

visa.title: Documents for your visa route
visa.lead: Tick off what you already have. The list covers the documents that follow from the law. Your mission abroad may ask for further formalities, which you will find on its website.

firstDay.title: From job offer to your first day
firstDay.lead: You have the contract. What follows is a series of steps that build on each other: visa, a place to stay, the move, and the paperwork in your first weeks. Tick them off as you go.
firstDay.callTitle: Want an overview of your next steps?
firstDay.callText: In the Germany Immigration Call (€59) we go through your situation and the official sources together.

tracker.title: Your applications
tracker.lead: Every application with its next step: what you need to do and by when. When the day comes, the portal asks you what happened and suggests the step after.
tracker.countFree: {{count}} of {{limit}} applications used on the Free plan
tracker.empty: No applications yet. Add the first one, and the portal keeps track of the next step for you.
tracker.limitText: The Free plan holds up to {{limit}} applications. Starter and Plus have no limit.
tracker.limitToast: The Free plan holds up to 10 applications.

apply.label: Apply
apply.hint: Send your application by this date. Earlier is better, job ads can go offline without notice.

follow_up.label: Follow up
follow_up.hint: If you have not heard back by this date, send a short email asking about the status. The template is under CV and cover letter.

interview.label: Interview
interview.hint: Prepare with the interview guide and German for the job. You get a reminder by email the day before.

documents.label: Send documents
documents.hint: The employer has asked for further documents. Send them by this date.

decision.label: Ask about the decision
decision.hint: If you have not heard back after the interview by this date, ask politely about the timeline.

offer_reply.label: Reply to the offer
offer_reply.hint: Reply to the offer by this date. Compare the contract terms first, see Employment contract.

none.label: No next step
none.hint: This application is closed. You find it in the history of the application.

tracker.addIntro: Enter the company and the position. The next step is suggested from the status, you can change it later.
tracker.errorUrl: Please enter the full link, starting with https://.
tracker.duplicate: You already have an open application at {{company}}. Save again to add it anyway.
tracker.editIntro: Change the status, the next step or your notes. When you change the status, the portal suggests a matching next step.
tracker.contactHint: For example the name and role from a reply email: Ms Weber, HR.
tracker.notesHint: Please don't enter sensitive personal information.
tracker.deleteConfirm: Click again to delete for good
